requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: Firmware 0.9.2 keeps GLOBAL's playing settings after a power-off: KEYS, OCTAVE, KEY VEL, FOLLOW, QUANTISE, AUTO STEP, MIDI CH and MIDI MAP. Any project save stores them, and so does a tap of SAVE on GLOBAL. They are read once at start-up, never in SAFE MODE.

Projects can have an 8-letter name: on PROJECTS, KNOB 2 picks the place and KNOB 3 the letter, and the slot shows it. Saves from earlier firmware load as before, with no name. The LXR's FX parameters, which did nothing on the FM-1, are no longer kept.

The installer now accepts the update loader under any ota- name. One FM-1 came back from the handover as ota-FM1C_0000000000000000, and the installer timed out waiting for another name. The cause is not known.

0.9.1 runs on one unit with the keys, MIDI MAP and projects, and 0.9.0 there with sound, USB audio, MIDI notes, MIDI clock over USB and saving. 0.9.2 has not run on a device: it is tested on the host and in the FM-1 emulator, including under the chip's alignment rule. Bluetooth, long runs and leaving for official firmware are untested.
If PROJECTS says FLASH IN USE, tap SAVE and confirm: this erases four sectors of user Flash that stock firmware may have left data in. Nothing is erased until you confirm.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
